raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: yaxt
  version: "0.12.2.1"
  build: 1
  mpi: ${{ mpi | default("mpich") }}
  mpi_prefix: mpi_${{ mpi }}
  # `yaxt * *_idxtype_long_*` for the 64-bit Xt_int build (see idxtype below)
  # yaxt's Xt_int index type defaults to a 32-bit int unless configured with
  # --with-idxtype=long (64-bit). Some consumers (e.g. LFRic, whose halo-index
  # type is 64-bit) need the 64-bit build; changing the *default* build's ABI
  # would break existing consumers pinned to today's (32-bit) `yaxt`, so this
  # is a second, additive, opt-in variant instead -- same pattern as `mpi`.
  idxtype: ${{ idxtype | default("int") }}
  idxtype_suffix: ${{ "" if idxtype == "int" else "_idxtype_" + idxtype }}

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/pism/${{ name }}-mirror/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9915741a03b0df3cc721e9de665a3b8cf5909b632c2aeee104deb30dfba06d61

build:
  number: ${{ build }}
  skip:
   - win
  # Build string so packages can depend on mpi/idxtype variants explicitly:
  #   `yaxt * mpi_mpich_*` for mpich
  #   `yaxt * mpi_openmpi_*` for openmpi
  #   `yaxt * mpi_*` for any mpi
  string: ${{ mpi_prefix }}${{ idxtype_suffix }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build }}


requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - autoconf
    - automake
    - libtool
    - make
    - pkg-config
    # openmpi's mpicc/mpifort wrappers are compiled binaries for the target
    # arch; when cross-compiling (e.g. osx-64 -> osx-arm64) they can't run on
    # the build machine, so we need a build-arch copy of openmpi too (mpich's
    # wrappers are portable shell scripts and don't need this). Same pattern
    # as conda-forge/libpnetcdf-feedstock.
    - if: (mpi == "openmpi") and (build_platform != target_platform)
      then: ${{ mpi }}
  host:
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
    - ${{ mpi }}
  run:
    - ${{ mpi }}
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, upper_bound='x.x') }}
    - ${{ name }} * ${{ mpi_prefix }}${{ idxtype_suffix }}_*

tests:
  - requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    files:
      recipe:
        - test_idxtype.c
    script:
      - if: linux
        then:
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libyaxt.so
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libyaxt_c.so
      - if: osx
        then:
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libyaxt.dylib
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libyaxt_c.dylib
      - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/yaxt.h
      - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/yaxt.mod
      - if: build_platform == target_platform
        then:
          - ${PREFIX}/bin/mpicc -I${PREFIX}/include -L${PREFIX}/lib -Wl,-rpath,${PREFIX}/lib -DXT_EXPECTED_TYPE=${{ idxtype }} test_idxtype.c -o test_idxtype -lyaxt
          - ./test_idxtype

about:
  summary: Yet Another eXchange Tool (yaxt) for coupling of Earth system model components.
  description: |
    Yet Another eXchange Tool (yaxt) is a lightweight software library for coupling of Earth system model components
    which provides automated data redistributions in distributed memory applications.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://gitlab.dkrz.de/dkrz-sw/yaxt
  repository: https://gitlab.dkrz.de/dkrz-sw/yaxt
  documentation: https://dkrz-sw.gitlab-pages.dkrz.de/yaxt/index.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jhkennedy
    - ckhroulev
    - aaschwanden
    - larsbuntemeyer
    - ickc
